Author:     Brendan Abolivier <brendan@thunderbird.net>

Commit:     Brendan Abolivier <brendan@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Wed Sep 25 16:14:49 2024 +0000

    Bug 1918460 - Sort local dependencies when generating gkrust's manifest. r=rjl
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D223491

diff --git a/python/rocbuild/rocbuild/rust.py b/python/rocbuild/rocbuild/rust.py
index 82998d30a4b..56273dcc439 100644
--- a/python/rocbuild/rocbuild/rust.py
+++ b/python/rocbuild/rocbuild/rust.py
@@ -429,7 +429,11 @@ def regen_toml_files(command_context, workspace):
         "version": "0.1.0",
         "path": mozpath.join(command_context.topsrcdir, "toolkit", "library", "rust", "shared"),
     }
-    for i in local_deps.keys():
+
+    # Sort the local dependencies. We do this in the reverse alphabetical order,
+    # because we insert them in the global list in the reverse order (so they
+    # end up on top in the final file).
+    for i in sorted(local_deps.keys(), reverse=True):
         keys.insert(0, i)
 
     keys.insert(0, "gkrust-shared")
diff --git a/rust/gkrust/Cargo.toml b/rust/gkrust/Cargo.toml
index 3ad02c6c9ce..4bea8211a82 100644
--- a/rust/gkrust/Cargo.toml
+++ b/rust/gkrust/Cargo.toml
@@ -16,8 +16,8 @@ harness = false
 [dependencies]
 mozilla-central-workspace-hack = { version = "0.1", features = ['gkrust'], optional = true }
 gkrust-shared = { version = "0.1.0", path = "../../../toolkit/library/rust/shared" }
-sys_tray = { version = "0.1.0", path = "../sys_tray" }
 ews_xpcom = { version = "0.1.0", path = "../ews_xpcom" }
+sys_tray = { version = "0.1.0", path = "../sys_tray" }
 aa-stroke = { git = "https://github.com/FirefoxGraphics/aa-stroke", rev = "d94278ed9c7020f50232689a26d1277eb0eb74d2" }
 app_services_logger = { path = "../../../services/common/app_services_logger" }
 audio_thread_priority = { version = "0.32" }
